caption: A frying pan straight off a high flame is put under a running tap, and the water hisses into a burst of steam and spits.

sa.check: A frying pan is held under a running tap.
A burst of steam rises as the water meets the pan.
The water spits from the pan.
The steam fades as the pan cools.
The pan comes off the flame first and goes under the tap after.
The burst is fiercest at first.

pc.expect: The steam bursts at the instant the water meets the pan and not before.
pc.fail: The steam bursts before the water reaches the pan; or the water runs onto the pan and no steam appears at all; or the steam bursts from the pan's handle rather than its face; or the steam appears with the pan held clear of the stream.

pc.expect: The burst is fiercest at first and then eases as the pan cools; it does not build up again with the tap running steadily.
pc.fail: The burst grows steadily stronger the longer the tap runs; or the burst stops and then starts again with nothing changed; or the steam runs back into the pan; or the pan's steam thickens after it has been taken out of the stream.

pc.expect: The water falls downward from the tap onto the pan while the steam rises and the spat droplets arc down again.
pc.fail: The water travels upward from the tap; or the steam sinks into the sink and pools; or the spat droplets rise and hang in the air; or the steam pours downward out of the pan.

pc.expect: The water is a thin liquid that bursts into fine droplets on the hot metal and runs off into the sink, and the pan stays a rigid pan.
pc.fail: The water beads up and rolls off the pan without wetting it or steaming; or the pan's metal visibly sags as the water hits; or the steam holds a fixed rigid shape; or the water sets solid in the pan.

pc.expect: One pan under one stream; the water goes from the tap onto the pan and into the sink.
pc.fail: Water appears in the pan with no stream reaching it; or the pan vanishes; or a second pan appears; or the water passes through the pan's base.

pc.expect: The pan's finish, the sink and the tap stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or the sink changes shape; or the tap changes design.

note: The hiss is sound and is not judged. Who holds the pan is not judged.
